Alternative Payments | Senior Software Engineer, Alti (AI agents) | REMOTE (Brazil) | Full-time | $90k–105k + equity

We’re building the financial operating system for service-based SMBs (accounts receivable, payables, analytics). Alti, our AI agent product, launched in July and is growing fast. We’re looking for a product-minded engineer who has shipped LLM, agent or RAG features to real users in the past year, to help us scale it: more agents, automated routines, eval pipelines and AI observability. Small squad, high ownership.

Stack: Go, TypeScript, Python, Postgres.

Apply: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/alternativepayments/76a7a829-d08d-4...
